title: Second-filtered Cartan--Eilenberg total lifts
statement: Let A and B be abelian, C Grothendieck abelian, F:A to B and G:B to C additive. For every CE presentation P [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation] there is a filtration L_P on its mapped total agreeing degreewise with the second filtration [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Every comparison d:P to Q has a filtered lift whose underlying map is the total of G(d.alpha). No left exactness, derived-category structure, spectral-sequence model, or homotopy-independence hypothesis is needed.

source.document: Stacks Project, Homological Algebra and Derived Categories
source.place: Tags 012Z (total differential and diagonal inclusions) and 015K (CE comparison maps).

proof.text: Negative horizontal vanishing and vertical extension by zero make each mapped CE bicomplex first quadrant. Apply boundedBelow_secondFiltration with lower bound zero.

Each total summand inclusion commutes with total maps. Consequently every generating image of a second-filtration step factors through the corresponding target step; the finite supremum universal property gives preservation of the step.

Restrict through the monic component inclusions. Cancelling these inclusions proves the chain-map equations, so the degreewise restrictions assemble into a map of subcomplexes and hence a filtered total lift.

lean.statement:
theorem cartanEilenberg_filtered_total_lifts
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A]
    {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] [Abelian B]
    {C : Type uC} [Category.{vC} C] [Abelian C] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vC} C]
    (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] (G : B ⥤ C) [G.Additive] :
    ∃ L : ∀ P : CartanEilenbergPresentation F, DecreasingFiltration (P.total G),
      (∀ (P : CartanEilenbergPresentation F) (p n : ℤ),
        (L P).complexStep p n =
          ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor G).obj P.I).secondFiltration n).step p)) ∧
      (∀ (P Q : CartanEilenbergPresentation F) (d : P.Comparison Q),
        ∃ t : (⟨P.total G, L P⟩ : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ)) ⟶
            (⟨Q.total G, L Q⟩ : FilteredObject (CochainComplex C ℤ)),
          t.hom = HomologicalComplex₂.total.map
            ((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor G).map d.α) (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
